about.title: Architectural Precision & Integrated Theater Engineering
about.story: Founded in February 2009 by senior audiovisual and architectural acoustics consultants, SHOMAN has established 15+ years of leadership supplying premier auditoriums, sports arenas, and cultural theaters across Egypt and Saudi Arabia.
about.feat1Desc: Strict compliance with BIFMA, CE, and NFPA fire and durability standards.
about.feat2Desc: Certified laboratory sound absorption testing up to 86% for pristine hall acoustics.

theater.title: Comprehensive Theater & Auditorium Systems
theater.desc: Delivering end-to-end architectural acoustics, motorized rigging, stage lighting, high-definition LED displays, and preventative maintenance.

seats.title: Auditorium & Theater Seating Systems
seats.desc: Architecturally crafted seating featuring silent gravity counterweight tip-up mechanisms and premium acoustic upholstery.

telescopic.title: Retractable Telescopic Bleacher Systems
telescopic.desc: Intelligent space flexibility for multipurpose arenas, sports facilities, and university lecture halls with premier safety standards.

options.title: Optional Features & Writing Tablets
options.desc: Laser-etched numbering, ADA row markers, and stowed anti-panic writing tablets engineered into the armrests.
